reason: Backend forbidden patterns and the lint/type/test bar this task must clear.
Frontend quality bar including accessibility and performance checks for the new chat components.

Its Quality Check section is the backend sign-off list: ownership filters on every user-scoped query, Zod at every boundary, migrations generated not hand-written and applying from an empty database, and no secret or message content in logs.
Its Quality Check section is the frontend sign-off list: no server state duplicated into Zustand, 'use client' at the narrowest component, both breakpoints verified, and no key reaching client props.

Verify the streaming rules held: no status change after headers, errors delivered inside the stream, disconnect treated as resumable rather than cancelled, assistant message persisted server-side. Also confirm D11's deliberate deviation is scoped to extracted fields with the key scrubbed, not the raw body.
Verify chat_messages follows the schema conventions, the cascade chain from users through topics is complete, and no query touching messages is missing its ownership filter.
Verify the full upstream error body is logged with redaction and that no message content or API key reached any log line.

Verify the state boundary held under pressure: messages stayed in Query, the picked model stayed client state with only its initial value derived, and the active topic stayed URL state rather than drifting into the store.

Verify useChat owns only the in-flight turn, history seeds it from a query hook with a key factory, error and status are handled explicitly, and the transport is injectable rather than hardcoding global fetch.

Cross-check the written code against the real ai@7 / @ai-sdk/react@4 API, since the widely documented v4 form compiles in places while behaving differently. Its pitfall list names the silent failures worth auditing for specifically: a missing consumeStream, req.signal cancelling persistence on disconnect, persistence attached to streamText instead of the UI-message layer, omitted originalMessages, and top-level api/body on useChat being ignored.

This task spans data, service, transport, and UI while deleting a shipped chain; check that existing helpers were reused rather than reimplemented and that no dead export survived the create-topic removal.
